text:
maria: Hey team — thinking of doing a casual Movie Night + Sandwich Swap next Friday at 6pm in the common room. :popcorn: :sandwich: Who's in?

alex: In! Can we do something PG-13? final exams looming haha.

sam: I'm down. Also down to organize a tiny sandwich raffle — whoever brings a creative sammie gets a $20 shop card? :raised_hands:

leo: Love it. Can people bring drinks? We have a mini fridge but not much space.

maria: Yup drinks ok. Maybe keep alcoholic stuff to small bottles? We'll be in the shared lounge.

jordan: Vote on movie here — reply with the emoji for your pick: 1) :film_strip: Action (Die Hard vibes) 2) :comedy: Comedy (Office-style rom-com) 3) :horror: Thriller (light) 4) :family: Feel-good indie

sam: 1️⃣ for Action

alex: 2️⃣ comedy please

leo: 4️⃣ — feel-good sounds good after a long week

maria: 3️⃣ if everyone else skips I'll pick thriller, but leaning 4️⃣ too.

jordan: Cool — looks like 4️⃣ wins so far.

maria: Quick poll for sandwich types to avoid duplicates — reply with the shorthand: "V" for veg, "C" for cold cuts, "H" for hot, "G" for gluten-free. Also note any allergies.

alex: C (no nuts)

sam: H — bringing mini meatball subs

leo: V (gluten-free bread pls)

jordan: C

maria: G (I'll bring hummus + roasted veg gf wraps)

eventbot: Reminder set! I'll post a 1-day reminder and a 2-hour reminder on event day.

alex: Logistics q — projector? we have the office one but need HDMI adapter. Anyone got one?

sam: I have an HDMI->USB-C dongle I can bring.

leo: Bringing a Bluetooth speaker (not huge).

jordan: I'll handle the signup sheet — drop a quick RSVP below if you're definitely coming so I can estimate seating.

maria: RSVP list so far: alex, sam, leo, jordan, maria. If anyone else wants in ping here.

alex: Quick add — I can bring extra napkins and plates.

sam: I can bring a small cutting board + knife for sandwich station.

maria: Awesome. I'll make a tiny name-tag sticker sheet and print labels for dietary notes. See you all Friday! :smile:
